responsibility: Implements language hooks and utility routines shared by the C++ and Objective-C++ front ends. It supplies cp-specific alias-set rules, tree-size allocation for C++ tree codes, type-compatibility and variably-modified-type checks, debug-type rewriting and DWARF attribute decisions, builtin-name recognition, dump registration, tree-code initialization via cp_common_init_ts, and common option handling such as module-related switches.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared C++/Objective-C++ hook behavior itself—such as alias-set logic, tree-node sizing/init, DWARF/debug attribute decisions, dump registration, builtin-name checks, and option handling—where cp-objcp-common.h only declares those entry points and wires them into LANG_HOOKS.
